content:
The shaded region is the six corner triangles outside the inner midpoint hexagon.

The inner midpoint hexagon is similar to the outer hexagon with side length \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) times the outer side length, so its area is
\[
\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^2=\frac34
\]
of the outer hexagon’s area:
\[
\frac34 \cdot 216 = 162.
\]
Thus the shaded area is
\[
216 - 162 = 54.
\]
\[
\boxed{54}
\]
